From intake to approval, Lamar automates the key processes behind specialty medications in one connected workflow. Patient records are retrieved, clinical documentation is assembled, and prior authorizations are submitted and tracked, with minimal manual intervention.

Now, pharmacy and medical benefit prior auths are filled from the record, submitted through the right channel and tracked to the determination. Site of care and J-codes are handled for infusion and buy-and-bill.

Most pharmacies know how many prescriptions they process. Far fewer know where time is lost, why authorizations are denied, which providers are sending fewer referrals, or which workflows cost the most.

CloudRx is a leading nationwide specialty pharmacy with deep expertise in fertility medications and prior authorizations. Their team is skilled at navigating carve-outs, complex routing, and payer requirements - but scaling this work was becoming increasingly difficult.

As CloudRx grew to support more than 8,000 patients per month, the manual prior authorization process consumed too much staff time. Each request could take 20+ minutes to complete, limiting throughput and requiring additional headcount. To maintain accuracy and timeliness, CloudRx needed a way to scale operations without sacrificing quality.

CloudRx partnered with Lamar Health to automate their prior authorization workflow. Lamar’s AI verifies referral packets, validates required data, and completes submissions in a fraction of the time - reducing manual work and accelerating patient access.
With Lamar’s automation in place, CloudRx achieved measurable improvements: 97% decreased employee time spent on PA's, 98% accuracy on intake, 7% increase in first time approvals.

CloudRx can now process thousands of prior authorizations each month without adding headcount. The partnership has transformed a high-volume, error-prone process into a reliable, scalable system-allowing CloudRx to continue expanding with new providers and life science partners while maintaining operational excellence.
